title: Global Sports Roundup: Saints waive, Bison FBS debut, Shaw’s pick & NBA warning
flags: The New Orleans Saints have waived rookie kicker **Charlie Smyth** after a tight competition with Dan Carlson.
The **North Dakota State Bison** stepped onto the FBS stage and delivered a “huge win,” with head coach Tim Polasek getting emotional after the victory.
Manchester United’s **Luke Shaw** sparked conversation after naming a teammate – **not Bruno Fernandes** – as the player of the match in United’s 5‑2 demolition of Ipswich at Old Trafford.
The **Los Angeles Lakers** have warned that **Austin Reaves** could see a decline in production now that **LeBron James** is set to leave.
The **Las Vegas Raiders** are reportedly juggling a quarterback competition between **Kirk Cousins** and **Fernando Mendoza**.
